tiktok.title: How a QR Code Repairs Itself With Reed-Solomon Error Correction
tiktok.caption:
A QR code adds extra bytes calculated from your link, using the same Reed-Solomon math that kept scratched CDs playing. At the highest error-correction level, about 30% of the code's bytes can be rebuilt, so a logo or a scratch can be survived. The three large corner squares are different: they aren't data, they're how your camera finds the code, so covering one breaks it. Have you ever scanned a damaged QR code that still worked?

Images: QR code for mobile English Wikipedia.svg: brdall (CC0)

#ThatsTheMechanism #science #qrcode #reedsolomon #errorcorrection
